summary: Support prepared PCIe attention exchange and partial-island all-reduce for uneven TP/DCP groups
compatibility: Adds hierarchical all-reduce for 9/10 ranks and DCP attention exchange for 9/10/12 ranks. Partial-island default dispatch is capped at 32 KiB. Final-source GPU qualification is pending.
details: Bounds peer accesses and synchronization to ranks present in each island.
Retains compiled owner launchers through preparation and preserves paired-gather thread defaults.
Kimi paired projection and top-k exchange retain their existing supported group sizes.
